assignDescription: Assign a published plan version to a user. Their current active subscription is canceled first, so they never have two active subscriptions.
assignReasonPlaceholder: Why is this subscription being assigned?
assignUserPlaceholder: Search users by name or email
cancelDescription: Canceling ends the subscription. At period end keeps it active until the current period ends; immediate cancels it now.
cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why is this subscription being canceled?
description: Assign, cancel, and migrate customer subscriptions. A subscription always points at one plan version — its terms never change unless it is migrated.
migrateConfirmDescription: This migrates {count} subscription(s) to {plan} v{version}. Each migration is recorded with its reason and can be rolled back by migrating back.
migrateDescription: Move selected subscriptions to a new plan version. Nothing changes until you review the preview and confirm with a reason.
migrateNoPermission: You do not have permission to migrate subscriptions.
migrateNoUsersSelected: Select at least one user to preview the migration.
migratePreviewEmptyDescription: The selected users have no active subscription, or they are already on the target version.
migrateReasonPlaceholder: Why are these subscriptions being migrated?
migrateScopeAllDescription: Migrate every active subscription on the selected source version.
migrateScopeUsersDescription: Migrate only the users you pick below.
migrateSkipped: {count} skipped (no active subscription or already on target).
migrateSourcePlaceholder: Select a plan, then a version
migrateTruncated: Only the first 100 affected users are shown. This run migrates those 100; repeat the migration for the rest.
noSubscriptionDescription: This user has no active subscription and falls back to the default Free plan.
noSubscriptionsDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
noSubscriptionsEmptyDescription: No subscriptions yet. Assign a plan version to a user to create one.
overridesDescription: Per-user limits that override the subscription's plan version. Overrides apply on top of the plan; removing one restores the plan limit.
overridesEmptyDescription: Set an override to give this user a different limit than their plan.
searchPlaceholder: Search by user name or email
setOverrideDescription: One override per meter per user. Setting a new value replaces the existing override for that meter.
setOverrideReasonPlaceholder: Why is this limit being overridden?
title: Subscriptions
